headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Detroit Tigers took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense, and the Minnesota Twins edged out the Boston Red Sox 6-5.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Dylan Cease, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to a left hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Jose Quintana (Colorado Rockies), Erik Sabrowski (Cleveland Guardians), Cole Winn (Texas Rangers), Jake Irvin (Washington Nationals), Edward Cabrera (Chicago Cubs), Jonny DeLuca (Tampa Bay Rays), and Brant Hurter (Detroit Tigers).

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, while the Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Colton Cowser leading the Orioles' offense. Cowser hit a crucial home run, scoring two runs and driving in three, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run and drove in two runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Boston Red Sox 6-5, securing a hard-fought win. Willson Contreras led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 1-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a narrow win over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 2-1. Ben Brown was a standout performer for the Pirates, leading the team to victory.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Impact hitters for the Orioles included Chandler Simpson and Jonathan Aranda, while Richie Palacios and Victor Mesa Jr. led the Rays' offense.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Dylan Cease Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-hander Dylan Cease has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
